advice.do_not_share_pin: Ungabelani ne-PIN yakho noma i-OTP nalowo wonke — ngisho nabasebenzi be-Mukuru.
advice.do_not_pay_upfront: Imisebenzi yangempela namaphrojekthi enhlanhla azidingi ukukhokha phambilini.

advice.pause_and_confirm: Misa lo mthombo uqinisekise ubunikazi bomamukeli kuqala.
advice.report_scam: Bika lokhu ebhange lakho noma ku-SABRIC.
advice.trust_your_instincts: Uma kuzwa kungelungile, yima. Khuluma nomuntu othembekile ngaphambi kokuqhubeka.
advice.check_url: Hlola ikheli lewebhu ngokucophelela — abahlubuki basebenzisa amakheli afana kancane nangempela.

demo.sample_scams.fake_job: Amahle! Ukhethwe umsebenzi wasekhaya okhokha u-R5000/iviki. Ukuze uvule isikhundla sakho, khokha imali yokubhalisa ye-R500 nge-EFT ku-akhawunti 1234567. WhatsApp +27600000001 ukuqinisekisa.
demo.sample_scams.phishing: IBHANGE LASE-ABSA: I-akhawunti yakho imisiwe. Qinisekisa manje ku-www.absa-secure-login.co ukugwema ukuvaliwa kwaphakade.
demo.sample_scams.romance: Isithandwa sami, ngisesiqeshini eNew Dubai. Babamba impahla yami badinga u-$300 ukuyikhulula. Ngizokubuyisela uphindwe kabili ngifika. Sicela ungisiza, ngiyakuthanda.
demo.sample_scams.advance_fee: Umamukeli Othandekayo, ukhethwe ukwamukela u-$1.5 million kusukela esifubeni sika-Dr. James Okafor. Ukukhulula izimali, kuqala kufanele ukhokhe imali yokucubungula ye-$200.
demo.sample_scams.impersonation: ISAZISO SE-SARS: Unentela efanele ukubuyiselwa ye-R3 200. Yithola ku-www.sars-refund-portal.net phakathi kwamahora angama-24 noma ilahlekelwe.
